'''Rangos Lanar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the [[Duke/Legends|Duke]] of [[House Lanar]], one of the [[Great Houses of Alderaan]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. House Lanar was originally a vassal of [[House of Thul|House Thul]], but broke ties with the Thuls and became [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], preying on the Thuls' holdings. Duke Lanar was [[Death/Legends|slain]] during an Imperial assault on the [[Lanar Resupply Camp|Lanar resupply camps]] in the western [[Kaamos Territory]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Duke Rangos Lanar appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' where he will spawn during, and must be defeated to complete, the final stage of "Ravaged Resupply," the bonus mission for the Heroic mission "The Lanar Question" on Alderaan.<ref name="TOR" />
